sales_notes:
CRM notes — procurement push. Key points:
- Company: Radialhaven Labs, product org building a customer-facing in-app assistant + search personalization layer.
- Workload: mix of low-latency chat (p95 target <300ms), high-volume embedding generation for personalization & nightly rerank jobs.
- Current path: started with Hosted API (safe, fast onboarding) -> successful functional POC -> now negotiating Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.
- Pricing asks from customer:
  * Commit: prefers 100M tokens/month baseline, wants 3-month ramp (33% -> 66% -> 100%).
  * Burst: need "burst capacity" to 2x baseline for seasonal spikes (black friday-like traffic patterns for retail customers).
  * Overage: customer asks for simple overage math and cap; proposes 1.25x unit price after commit.
  * Ramp discounts: asked for front-loaded discount during ramp months, to ease cashflow.
- Redwood position (commercial): proposed tiers: 75M / 150M / 300M commit bands. Proposed initial offer: 100M commit at mid_market pricing, burst allowed up to 2x for up to 48 hours/month, overage billed at 1.5x unit price. 90-day SLA + canary fallback to hosted pool.
- POC requirements for capacity sign-off: 2-week capacity validation using production-like traffic (we will provide load harness). Targets: sustained 50 rps embedding generate, burst 150 rps for 10 mins, chat p95 <300ms across 90% of queries for 99th percentile cases.
- Security/compliance: require SSO/SAML integration, KMS for key import, audit logs, and data residency in US-EST region. Legal team wants SOC2 Type II report and sample audit logs.
- Stakeholders: Head of Product (Emily Rowan) - technical buyer; CTO (Derek Shaw) - budget & infra sign-off; Procurement (Lina Park) - contract terms.
- Quotes from calls: "We need predictability more than the absolute lowest cost — spikes kill conversion." — Emily Rowan.
- Risks: procurement timeline tight (wants May launch). If pricing not aligned, they will consider Anthropic Dedicated + self-managed caching.
- Other notes: customer requested a custom SLA metric for cold-start latency on first token for new sessions. SE to validate feasibility.
- Action items: AE to confirm final commit band + deliver revised SOW; SE to prepare capacity validation harness and run joint tests week of 3/8; Security to provide SOC2 artifact and KMS integration doc.
